body:
MINE GUARD CR 2

XP 600
CE Medium humanoid (human)
Init +1, Senses Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 11, flat-footed 15 (+1 Dex, +5 armor)
hp 26 (4d8 +8)
Fort +6, Ref +2, Will +1

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee halberd +7 (1d10 +3/x3)

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 13, Con 14, Int 12, Wis 11, Cha 9
Base Atk +3; CMB +6, CMD 17

SPECIAL ABILITIES

As One (Ex)

When an ally successfully strikes an opponent with an action, a mi ne guard may make use of his attack of opportunity to make an attack against that creature.

Defensive Sweep (Ex)

Mine guards make a combat maneuver roll when striking a target. If they succeed, the target is pushed 10 feet in a direction determined by the mine guard.
